svg.text: the gallery data and the install JSON.
Playwright plays each demo; ffmpeg cuts
a short loop in three sizes, plus a poster.
A vision model reads six frames of the clip
and the source, and writes ~30 facts:
what it is, how it moves, what it costs.
For people: looping clips, live previews,
search by describing, copy the source.
For the shadcn CLI, in any project:
code, npm deps, CSS and keyframes.
git push main → GitHub Actions builds → ships to the server → health check, or automatic rollback
